species.tagline: The red dragonfly of Shing Mun River

tasks.title: Look at the wings
tasks.message: Four wings, so thin you can see straight through them.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a scarlet skimmer. Four wings, thin enough to see through.

tasks.title: Why so red
tasks.message: Males are bright red all over; females are more yellow-brown.
tasks.subtitle: Males are bright red; females are yellow-brown. This one is a male.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: Baby dragonflies live in the water. Clean water is how they grow up.
tasks.subtitle: Baby dragonflies live in water. Clean water is how they grow. Thank you!
